name: Bloom Pack (Forge 1.20.1)
summary: Bloom Level-Up with Better Combat and Fresh Animations, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).
_comment: The Forge build's pack (FreshOrangeSlices, 2026-10-26): Bloom, Better Combat and the same Fresh Animations set as main's Bloom Pack (Entity Model/Texture Features, Not Enough Animations, Fresh Animations with its Details, Objects, Spiders, Creepers and Player add-ons, and the EMF compat mods that make Better Combat and Not Enough Animations work with them). Modrinth projects by slug (newest 1.20.1 Forge build; required dependencies are added automatically). Bloom is packed inside.

client_presets._resource_packs: Bottom to top, above vanilla's Default (and Forge's mod resources), same order as main's pack. Bloom switches them on before the game first reads options.txt, once per change of this list (client/mixin/OptionsMixin).
